hero.summary: Groundpath turns scattered source material into a reviewable answer workflow for teams that actually need to move answers into operations.
hero.support: Connect documents, scope the archive first, and keep citations, access boundaries, and freshness signals attached to every response instead of patching trust afterward.

console.answerBody: Use the existing SLA for procurement approval, but keep contract version differences and recency visible in the response.
console.scopeBody: Recall only from the current organization and knowledge boundary so unrelated context never leaks into the answer.
console.reviewBody: Freshness, access boundaries, and citation state stay visible before the answer moves into a real workflow.

proof.title: Not just better phrasing. Better verification.
proof.description: Groundpath pulls the three most failure-prone parts of knowledge work back into the system itself: source, boundary, and review.

rail.label: Operating principle
rail.title: Turn an answer from text output into an executable object.
rail.description: Once knowledge is structured as scoped archive objects, retrieval, response, and the next action can close the loop on the same evidence chain.

points.scope: Constrain the knowledge boundary before expanding model capability.
points.version: Keep source version, freshness, and citation entry points visible.
points.audit: Expose review state and potential gaps before the answer ships.

trace.title: Answers stay source-bound
trace.description: Citations are not attachments. They remain part of the answer itself.

boundary.title: Boundary before capability
boundary.description: Permissions, knowledge scope, and work objects are narrowed first, then the model is allowed to expand.

review.title: Review remains visible
review.description: Teams can see freshness, conflict, and missing evidence before action.

workflow.label: Source-grounded flow
workflow.title: Constrain the scope, then let the answer happen.
workflow.description: A compact but reliable workflow that keeps knowledge, citations, and review signals on the same system surface.

connect.title: Connect sources
connect.description: Bring documents, policy, and archived material onto one surface instead of scattering context across tools.

index.title: Establish identity
index.description: Give every source a stable identity, freshness signal, and retrieval boundary so answers keep their origin.

query.title: Query after scoping
query.description: Set the operating boundary first, then let the model answer with citations intact.

act.title: Act with evidence
act.description: Carry citations, permissions, and review signals into the next real workflow step instead of patching them later.

capabilities.label: Built for operating teams
capabilities.title: Compress archives, retrieval, and action into one surface.
capabilities.description: Groundpath is not just another model wrapper. It brings source management, answer constraints, and workflow actions back into one operating layer.

rag.title: Connect once, get source-tied answers immediately
rag.description: As soon as documents land in the system, they become retrieval-augmented answers with citations attached.
rag.signal: source-tied answers from the first sync

secure.title: Access boundaries stay inside the system by default
secure.description: Permissions, scope, and citations remain inside an auditable flow instead of living outside the model boundary.
secure.signal: audit boundary, access scope, and citations stay together

multimodal.title: One interface for model choice and working context
multimodal.description: Switch models, add context, and continue the thread without breaking the evidence chain.
multimodal.signal: change models and context on one surface

search.title: Keep recall, matching, and answers on one evidence chain
search.description: From archive organization to final response, retrieval and output keep pointing to the same source objects.
search.signal: retrieval and response align around the same evidence

cta.eyebrow: Ready for an evidence-first answer flow?
cta.title: Turn the first archive into the first executable answer.
cta.description: Start with one document set and turn it into an answer workflow your team can actually operate on.

board.label: Start with the first archive
board.title: Three steps to make answers operational

items.connect: Connect source material and define the knowledge boundary.
items.review: Expose citations, permissions, and freshness together.
items.deploy: Carry a reviewable answer into a real operational flow.

footer.description: Groundpath keeps archive intake, retrieval, and answer delivery traceable and reviewable from end to end.

hero.title: About Groundpath
hero.description: Groundpath is a knowledge archive workbench for teams that need retrieval, conversation, and verification to live on the same system surface.

trusted.title: Retrievable by design
trusted.description: Archive documents as structured objects so scope and recall remain stable under production use.

knowledge.title: Conversational in context
knowledge.description: Keep questions and answers inside the same archive space that defines their scope and evidence.

semantic.title: Verifiable under review
semantic.description: Expose citations, source freshness, and version state so every answer can be checked before action.
